key: Warfare is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you; but it may happen that ye hate a thing which is good for you, and it may happen that ye love a thing which is bad for you. Allah knoweth, ye know not.
s: Amid questions put to the Prophet, the believers are told that war is laid on them; al-Tabari, on 2:216, takes the duty as lifted from the rest once enough take it up, since those who stay behind are also promised good.

evidence.words: هو على كل واحد حتى يقوم به من في قيامه الكفاية، فيسقطُ فرض ذلك حينئذ عن باقي المسلمين، كالصلاة على الجنائز وغسلهم الموتى ودفنهم، وعلى هذا عامة علماء المسلمين. قال أبو جعفر: وذلك هو الصواب عندنا لإجماع الحجة على ذلك … فأخبر جل ثناؤه أنّ الفضل للمجاهدين، وأن لهم وللقاعدين الحسنى، ولو كان القاعدون مضيِّعين فرضًا لكان لهم السُّوأى لا الحسنى
evidence.gloss: (Others said:) it lies on every one until those whose undertaking suffices take it up, and then the duty falls from the rest of the Muslims, like the prayer over the dead and washing and burying them; and this is the view of the generality of Muslim scholars. Abu Jaʿfar (al-Tabari) said: that is the correct view in our judgement, for the consensus of the authorities on it … (citing 4:95) He, exalted, has told that the merit belongs to those who strive, and that for them and for those who stay behind alike is the good; had those who stay behind been neglecting a duty, theirs would have been the evil, not the good.

reason: Key verse verbatim (verse.js ok, Al-Baqarah 2:216, at 222). Plain sense faithful to day.js: 2:215, 2:217 and 2:219 are questions put to the Prophet (‘They ask thee’, ‘They question thee’), and 2:216 lays fighting on the believers; one plain clause, no four-word run from the verse. In the packet on 2:216 al-Tabari reports that some held the duty was on the Companions alone, that others held it binds each until enough take it up and then falls from the rest, and that others held it binds all until the Hour; he says the second is correct, by the consensus of the authorities and by 4:95, where both strivers and those who stay behind are promised the good, which could not be if the latter neglected a duty. The sentence carries exactly this preference and its reason. Evidence pieces re-found by squashed string match in the packet. 41 words; entry-check ok.
